body:
A reading for this issue, from the fuzz test of #1548 (`import_step_corner_blend::bent_corner_blends_end_cleanly_and_bounded`):

A one-corner rounded cube with the first weight row of its corner blend set to zeros (`RATIONAL_B_SPLINE_SURFACE(((0.0,0.0,0.0),...`) is refused by name, but only after **63.6 s** in a debug build with the evaluation cap lowered to 200,000. The other bent variants answer in 0.02 to 0.4 s. (Measured on an earlier draft of the fixture, a 20 mm cube with R4 rounds; not re-measured on the committed `testdata/models/fillet_corner.step`, which is the same construction at 30 mm / R3.125.) The surface evaluates to NaN along one side, and the time goes into truck's unmetered parameter searches for the boundary points (`search_parameter` / `search_nearest_parameter`, 100 Newton trials each, four strategies per point, every pass), not into the metered subdivision; where exactly was not profiled. It is bounded, so it is not a hang, but it is the same gap this issue names: only `subs` is metered. That variant was left out of the #1548 test to keep it under the 60 s law; it would make a pin here.
